config.name: Rows and size per signal table
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT table AS table_name, formatReadableQuantity(sum(rows)) AS rows, formatReadableSize(sum(bytes_on_disk)) AS on_disk, formatReadableSize(sum(data_compressed_bytes)) AS compressed, round(sum(data_compressed_bytes) / greatest(sum(data_uncompressed_bytes), 1), 3) AS ratio FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database = 'default' AND table LIKE 'otel_%' GROUP BY table ORDER BY sum(bytes_on_disk) DESC

config.name: Traces and logs per minute
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT ts, sum(spans) AS spans, sum(logs) AS logs FROM (SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS ts, count() AS spans, 0 AS logs FROM default.otel_traces GROUP BY ts UNION ALL SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS ts, 0 AS spans, count() AS logs FROM default.otel_logs GROUP BY ts) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

config.name: Volume by service
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT ServiceName AS service, count() AS spans, round(avg(Duration / 1e6), 2) AS avg_ms, max(Timestamp) AS last_seen FROM default.otel_traces GROUP BY service ORDER BY spans DESC LIMIT 50

config.name: Retention (TTL) per table
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT table AS table_name, extract(engine_full, 'TTL ([^ ]+(?: [^ ]+){0,3})') AS ttl FROM system.tables WHERE database = 'default' AND table LIKE 'otel_%' AND engine_full LIKE '%TTL%' ORDER BY table

config.name: Active parts and merges
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT table AS table_name, count() AS active_parts, max(modification_time) AS newest_part FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database = 'default' AND table LIKE 'otel_%' GROUP BY table ORDER BY active_parts DESC
